tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search public Property Passports within one country or territory. Country alone is enough. Town, region, bedrooms, guest capacity and property type are optional refinements. Returns up to 10 matching accommodation units, preferring different Property Passports. No catalogue export, total count or pa

tools.name: get_property_passport
tools.description: Retrieve one exact public Property Passport returned by search_stays. Accepts only a canonical https://openstays.ai/stays/... URL. The Passport follows the schema at https://openstays.ai/passport-schema/latest/passport.schema.json.
